column1: # Display escaping of untrusted text (device name, relay host, offered app id and
# origin): vault-server's approver prints them with Rust's str::escape_debug, and
# android/core's Untrusted.display must give the same text, except that quotes
# stay unescaped (they are not delimiters on a screen). Pinned on both sides by
# One case per line: input<TAB>expected display. The input column is written in
# the same notation: \u{hex} is that code point and \\ a backslash (so the
# vectors can hold controls and tabs); the expected column is literal.
